name: usage-budget
description: Warns as the account's 5-hour and 7-day usage windows fill, tells the model as they near the limit, and refuses new subagents past a set percent

spawnGatePercent.title: Refuse new subagents at (percent)
spawnGatePercent.description: When either usage window reaches this percent, a new subagent spawn is refused. 0 turns the refusal off.

warnPercents.title: Warn at (percents, comma separated)
warnPercents.description: Each time a usage window first reaches one of these percents, you get a toast. It starts over when the window resets.

tellModelAtPercent.title: Tell the model from (percent)
tellModelAtPercent.description: From this percent on, the model also gets a one-time note on its next tool result, so it can wrap up. 0 never tells the model.
